text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Waking up to a sense of unease, I found 
myself in a bed in an unfamiliar hospital 
room. While wondering what had happened—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer-chan! You shouldn't sit up so 
suddenly!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
My back is in rough shape! Remember? On 
the way to the airport—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-chan, thanks for walking with me! 
This train goes straight to the airport, 
so I'm set from here.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Papa, you have another flight this 
evening, so we can only talk for a little 
bit, but—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I only get to see Papa a few times a year, 
so let's chat a whole bunch!
choice_data_list:
Then maybe it's better to keep it just for 
family...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
No! I wanted to introduce you, Trainer! 
And Papa said it was too dangerous for me 
to come alone—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Trainer-chan, step to this side! Looks 
like the grandma behind you can't get 
through.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Behind me stood an elderly woman with a 
carry-on suitcase. I hurriedly stepped 
aside to make way.

text_block_list.name: Old Lady with Heavy Luggage
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, but that's a big help. I can't 
hold onto the hand strap while carrying 
this.
choice_data_list:
Shall I put it on the luggage rack for 
you?

text_block_list.name: Old Lady with Heavy Luggage
text_block_list.text:
My, my... How kind of you. However, this 
is exceedingly heavy. So...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Creek...!!)

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? Trainer, what's wrong?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: T-Trainieee!?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
And so, with Trainer-chan passed out from 
the pain, we rushed 'em to the hospital in 
an ambulance.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"I didn't go see them! There's no way I 
could just leave Trainer-chan alone."
choice_data_list: Never mind me, get to the airport!
Don't worry about me, get to the airport!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry! I made sure to message Papa 
and tell him "I'm sorry."

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
So Maya's staying right here today. I'm 
gonna nurse Trainer-chan back to health!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Geez! It's fine, it's totally fine! More 
importantly, lay down and let Maya nurse 
you back to health!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Maya's studying to be a mature woman, so 
my nursing skills are top-notch! For 
example~.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Pain, pain, go away~! Zoom off as fast as 
an eagle, whoosh☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
See? Doesn't hurt anymore, does it! My 
mama used to do that for me! Next up—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
It's lunchtime~! But since you can't move, 
Trainer-chan...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Maya'll feed you! Say 'aaah'♪ Come on, 
open wide~?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Okaaay! Next up is naptime~ Maya will tuck 
you all in, okay?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
One F-1 jet... two F-2 jets... Ah, by the 
way, the aircraft Papa flies is—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Wait, no, no! I gotta put them to sleep! 
...Alright, one more time!
choice_data_list: Maybe I should go see them after all...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer-chan. You know, Papa is Maya's 
idol... and I love him, okay?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Still... Trainer-chan, you're Maya's 
precious, dearest partner.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I want you to always stay healthy and full 
of energy. I want you to keep shining 
bright right next to Maya.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
So let Maya support you! Just like you 
always do for me, Trainer-chan!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Let Maya stay right here. So please, rest 
easy and get better... pretty please.
choice_data_list: Don't worry, I'll be better in no time!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Let Maya stay right here. So please, rest 
easy and get better... pretty please.
choice_data_list: Don't worry, I'll be better in no time!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: ...! ...Yeah, absolutely!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Maya was seriously worried! You collapsed 
all of a sudden and looked in pain... I 
was so worried and scared.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
*Sniff*... Don't go collapsing out of 
nowhere like that again, okay? Next time 
you collapse...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Only when your heart's beating so fast for 
Maya that you can't take it anymore, okay!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Just kidding... ehehe...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Thanks to the devoted nursing care, the 
lower back pain cleared up completely, 
leading to a smooth discharge from the 
hospital."

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ahem! Leave it to me~! I'll fill you right 
up with energy☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! Dad mentioned it on the phone 
too. He said, 'If there's another chance, 
I'd love to say hello!'

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"Your voice sounded so serious, it 
startled me! I've only ever heard you 
speak so gently."

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: You gotta get well soon, Trainer-chan!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Already nervous about what kind of speech 
would be demanded of them... they focused 
on recuperation and were safely discharged 
from the hospital.
